footer.aboutText: Nadzin is a store of professional digital goods for artists. We offer quality brushes and illustrations for digital art.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your personal data.
privacy.section1Text: This Privacy Policy determines the procedure for processing and protecting personal data of users of the Nadzin website.
privacy.section2Text: We collect the following personal data: name, email address, payment information when placing an order.
privacy.section3Text: Your data is used for order processing, customer communication, service improvement, and sending newsletters.
privacy.section4Text: We apply modern data protection methods to ensure the security of your personal information.
privacy.section5Text: You have the right to access, correct, and delete your personal data. Contact us to exercise these rights.
privacy.section6Text: If you have questions about the privacy policy, contact us by email.

licenses.title: Terms of Use of Digital Goods (Licenses)
licenses.personalLicenseDesc: Intended for non-commercial use for personal purposes.
licenses.personalAllowed1: Use in personal creative projects that do not generate income.
licenses.personalAllowed2: Decorating personal social media accounts (not business profiles).
licenses.personalAllowed3: Printing for personal use (gifts for loved ones, home decor) in single copies.
licenses.personalForbidden1: Any commercial use (selling goods with this design).
licenses.personalForbidden2: Use in advertising or promotion of services/brands.
licenses.personalForbidden3: Resale, sharing files with third parties, or posting in public access.
licenses.commercialLicenseDesc: Intended for small businesses and individual entrepreneurs.
licenses.commercialAllowed1: Creation and sale of up to 500 units of final products (physical or digital: postcards, merch, packaging, prints).
licenses.commercialAllowed2: Use in one business social media account and one website of the Buyer.
licenses.commercialAllowed3: Use in digital design where the original resource cannot be extracted by third parties.
licenses.commercialForbidden3: Resale of original files in any form (even after editing).
licenses.extendedLicenseDesc: Intended for large-scale commercial projects and branding.
licenses.extendedAllowed1: Use without circulation limit (unlimited quantity of product units).
licenses.extendedAllowed2: Creation of logos, corporate identity, and trademarks (without exclusive ownership rights to original elements, as they may be sold to others).
licenses.extendedAllowed3: Use in physical advertising (billboards, print materials) and in unlimited number of business accounts/websites of the Buyer.
licenses.extendedAllowed4: Use in mobile applications and games.
licenses.extendedForbidden1: Resale "as is", sublicensing, or transferring files as an independent resource.
licenses.extendedForbidden2: Placement on stock sites, in photo banks, or use in NFT projects.
licenses.generalRestrictions: The Buyer is not entitled to:
licenses.restriction1: Claim to be the author of the work (even after making significant edits).
licenses.restriction2: Share download links or transfer original files to third parties.
licenses.restriction3: Include products in digital sets/constructors for resale where the original element can be extracted in its original form.
licenses.restriction4: Use products in projects that violate Russian and Belarusian law, promote hatred or discrimination.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: Our cookie policy explains what cookies are and how we use them.
cookies.section1Text: A cookie is a small text file that is stored on your device when visiting a website.
cookies.section2Text: We use necessary cookies for website functionality, analytical cookies for service improvement, and functional cookies to remember your preferences.
cookies.section3Text: You can disable cookies in your browser settings. However, this may affect website functionality.
cookies.section4Text: We may use third-party analytics services such as Google Analytics, which may also set cookies.
